It distinguishes itself from standard voxel texturing by combining triplanar mapping with a slope-aware material blending system that adapts to the local surface orientation, preventing texture stretching and maintaining visual continuity despite the irregular vertex distribution of the Transvoxel mesh.
The method operates in the vertex and fragment shaders of the Transvoxel renderer.
It computes material weights based on block type, slope, and procedural noise, then blends between base colors or texture samples.
